Source: krds-uiux npm package 1.1.0
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/krds-uiux
Project: https://github.com/KRDS-uiux/krds-uiux

This directory vendors official KRDS css, js, font, and image resources for the cms-admin-bff
Thymeleaf UI. Original KRDS resource files are copied without local edits.

Addition (2026-09-16): fonts/PretendardGOV-SemiBold.subset.{woff2,woff} from orioncactus/pretendard v1.3.9
(packages/pretendard-gov/dist/web/static/*-subset, OFL 1.1). Same subset build as the krds-uiux 1.1.0 files
(Regular sha256 identical); added because the Figma design uses weight 600 heavily and the package ships only 400/500/700.
